name: Friends Brunch Package
shortDescription: A sociable spread of shareable favourites for a group of friends.
fullDescription: Built for an upbeat table, this package offers a generous mix of brunch favourites, refreshing drinks, and a shared dessert with plenty of time to catch up.
whoItSuits: A small group of friends looking for shared dishes, drinks, and an easy social atmosphere.
optionalNotes: The displayed price is a concept placeholder, not a confirmed price from The Pizza House. The table can note dietary preferences when enquiries open.
